title: Seazn capture beat, v1: POST /api/v1/capture/codes/{code}/beats
description: The phone's heartbeat body (capture QR v2 spec 2026-10-01 §6.3.2; `at` amended §17.5, R5 final, agreed with capture 2026-10-01). Strict: anything malformed is 422, which the phone counts as a failed beat. $defs.answer is the 200 answer (§6.3.3). A beat never answers 410 (ask 8). Vendored into the capture repo; its sha256, parity with its zod twin and its fixtures are pinned by apps/web/src/server/api-v1/__tests__/capture-contract.test.ts.

claim.description: "new" or "resume" on a claim beat, otherwise null (§6.5, ask 2). A claim rides only until the pairing's first 2xx, so it is never together with cause "rejoin" (a rejoin follows a 2xx live); the server refuses that pair with 422 (D16).

device.description: {model} on a claim beat, Build.MODEL only, otherwise null; read only on a claim (G0-e, §6.3.2).

sid.description: The session this phone holds, or null (§6.3.2).

at.description: When the phone took the beat: ISO-8601 with any offset; a value with no zone is refused. The server normalises it to UTC before storing it; the phone sends Z (§17.5, R5).

state.description: The phone's own state, in kebab-case (§6.3.2, §4).

cause.description: Why the broadcast this phone holds was started (§6.3.2). Non-null only while sid is non-null (a broadcast is held), otherwise null; never "rejoin" on a claim beat. The server refuses either breach with 422 (D16, capture's field-by-field check 2026-10-01).

stopped.description: A session this phone stopped; only while sid is null (§6.3.2, capture RR3, §6.8.2).

answer.description: The 200 answer to a beat (§6.3.3; amended §17.5, R5 final): a union on `state`. The first precedence row that applies wins: taken, replaced, over, waiting, go-live, live. The common fields (label, scheduledStart, autoAllowed, destinationName, overlayUrl, pollSeconds) are required on waiting, go-live, live and over, and optional on replaced and taken; PR-1's server still sends them on every 2xx (ask 1). sid, startedBy and endReason are omitted where they do not apply, never null.

oneOf.description: The slot is empty, paired or starting; while starting, pollSeconds is 5 (§6.3.3 rows 4 and 5).

label.description: "{side A} v {side B}", or "Match {n}" in the competition's locale while a side is not yet known; at most 200 characters, cut with one "…" (§6.4, W25, §17.6).

scheduledStart.description: fixtures.scheduled_at as epoch seconds, or null when the fixture has none (§6.4, §4).

autoAllowed.description: Whether the server may start the broadcast on its own; always false in PR-1 (§6.4, §7.1).

destinationName.description: The pre-picked destination's label, at most 80 characters cut with one "…"; null when there is none or it is archived (§6.4, §6.7.3, §17.6).

overlayUrl.description: The scorebug overlay page, or null when the org lacks streaming.overlay (§6.4.1, W11, W18).

pollSeconds.description: How often the phone polls and beats, 5 to 300 seconds (§6.6, §6.9).
